The point I'm trying to make is that I don't have the time to put effort in to posting comments or other contributions, but i would like to be able to vote on what others post and thereby at least doing a little bit to alter the stuff posted. It is not the point of CCP to prevent lurkers voting, rather to prevent bots or other automatically voting.
Voting is a privilege here. In order to vote more, you need to contribute something to the site. Why give you upvotes when you're not even going to comment or post anything?
I see the point you are making, but I feel that voting is a form of contributing. I guess I'll try commenting relevant stuff on hot posts until i've gotten my CCP.

You're right: it's a form of contributing. But, the reason it's a privilege is because, when you vote, you move the posts/comments up and down. If you comment or post and gain SCP and CCP that way, you show the community that you know what's relevant to a community, thereby allowing you the ability to up- and downvote.

This subverse was made as a way to get CCP in a way that's easy: talking about yourself. Unwind, spill your thoughts, and discuss you. Though it's not technically against Voat's rules, comments like the one you posted is vote manipulation to circumvent the limits and I deeply encourage you to play by the rules and have fun the way it's supposed to be.
